title: Why Every Protest Matters: Lessons from Bangladesh, India and Nepal - The Daily Star
description: Why Every Protest Matters: Lessons from Bangladesh, India and Nepal  The Daily Star
publisher.title: The Daily Star
full_article:
In hindsight, revolutions are easy to predict. Years, decades and even centuries after such events, scholars will write volumes explaining how prevailing conditions made such violent action inevitable, with the most common preconditions being extreme economic inequality and injustice along with an oppressive state which is not only prone to overreaction but is also so wedded to using force that it has forgotten all other means of conflict reduction and resolution.

What is next to impossible to predict is the single spark that sets off the explosion, the final straw that breaks the back of the ancient regime. And all too often, that spark is so small as to be insignificant and the straw is almost weightless compared to the existing burden accumulated over years.

Read more Who writes the history of the July Uprising?

In Bangladesh, the issue of job reservations led to the swift end of Hasina Wajed’s 15-year reign and resulted in her fleeing the country, but how many jobs were actually reserved this way? According to most calculations, they were no more than 1,000 at most and given Bangladesh’s population and relative economic prosperity one would imagine that this would have been a relatively minor issue. Certainly, Hasina Wajed — with the overconfidence and isolation that absolute power breeds — thought it would blow over. Instead, it blew her regime away.

Similarly, in Nepal, while anger over widespread political corruption, high unemployment and extreme economic inequality and frustration was the norm, the spark that led ‘Gen Z’ to riot was the government’s September 2025 ban on 26 social media platforms. While the government framed this as a regulatory measure, the protesters were convinced that the real reason for the ban was to block a social media trend that focused on the privileges and wealth of the children and close relatives of Nepal’s ruling class. The economic divide had always been a reality, but now, for the first time, a poor unemployed youngster in Nepal could see the sons and daughters of ministers live it up on Instagram, spending more on a single purchase than that youth could hope to earn in a lifetime.

By the time states get around to addressing the spark, the fire has spread. In Bangladesh, Hasina Wajed got the supreme court to reduce the reservation quota to seven per cent but it was too little, too late; the fuse had already been lit and the protests had become an uprising against authoritarianism and the loss of life during the government crackdown. Ensconced in her palace, one imagines that Hasina simply didn’t understand what had hit her.

What is next to impossible to predict is the single spark that sets off the explosion, the final straw that breaks the back of the ancient regime. And all too often, that spark is so small as to be insignificant and the straw is almost weightless compared to the existing burden accumulated over years.

In Nepal the government lifted the social media ban just a few days after imposing it but by that time several dozen protesters had been killed and government buildings set on fire. Four days after the ban was imposed, and one day after it was lifted, the prime minister had to resign.

India’s ‘cockroach’ movement was milder in comparison. However, it represented not just anger at exam leaks but a deeper frustration with a system seemingly fully captured by the Sangh agenda and networks. Despite the state’s surprise that time-tested heavy-handed tactics and media smears no longer seemed to work, it acted with far more foresight than its neighbours by addressing the central demands before the movement spread out of control and by not resorting to deadly force. The final fate of the movement remains to be decided, but for now, it seems the crisis has passed even though it exposed the chinks in Narendra Modi’s hitherto impenetrable armour.

Read more When work and leisure fail, does protest fill the void?

Often, state overreaction to a movement or protest causes that protest to balloon into rebellion and revolution even if that was not the original intention of the demonstrators. Case in point: a large but mostly peaceful procession of peasant workers led by Orthodox priest Father Georgy Gapon on Jan 9, 1905. Gapon was no revolutionary and nor were revolutionary elements prominent in the crowd. In fact, anti-tsar parties like the Bolsheviks had disapproved of the march due to its lack of political demands. Carrying icons and portraits of the tsar, the crowd regarded Nicholas II as their benevolent ‘little father’ whom, they hoped, would listen to their pleas and save them from exploitation. Instead, the crowd was fired upon by panicked imperial troops resulting in hundreds of deaths. Distraught and dismayed, surrounded by the dead and wounded, the previously pro-tsar Gapon was heard to shout: “There is no God any longer. There is no tsar.” And from here on, the days of imperial Russia were numbered.

Here then are lessons for all states, inc­luding our own: address concerns before they metastasize beyond treatment and just because a strategy has worked in the past there is no guarantee that it will not backfire in the present. Finally, never use a hacksaw when a scalpel is required.

This article was first published under the title “Tick, tick ... boom" in Dawn, an ANN partner of The Daily Star, on August 10, 2026.

Zarrar Khuhro is a journalist. His X handle is @zarrarkhuhro.

बांग्लादेश मे नौकरी आरक्षण के मुद्दा के कारण हसीना वाजेद के 15 साल के शासन के तेजी सं अंत भ गेल आओर एकर परिणामस्वरूप ओ देश सं भागि गेलखिन्ह, मुदा वास्तव मे एहि तरहे कतेक नौकरी आरक्षित भ गेल छल. अधिकांश गणना के अनुसार ई सब बेसी स बेसी एक हजार स बेसी नै छल आ बांग्लादेश के आबादी आ सापेक्षिक आर्थिक समृद्धि के देखैत कल्पना कयल जायत जे ई अपेक्षाकृत छोट मुद्दा रहैत. निश्चित रूप स हसीना वाजेद — अति आत्मविश्वास आ अलगाव जे निरपेक्ष सत्ता पैदा करैत अछि — सोचलक जे ई उड़ि जायत । बल्कि ओकर शासन के उड़ा देलक।

तहिना नेपाल मे जतय व्यापक राजनीतिक भ्रष्टाचार, उच्च बेरोजगारी आ चरम आर्थिक असमानता आ कुंठा पर आक्रोश आदर्श छल, ओतहि ‘जेन जेड’ के दंगा करय के कारण जे चिंगारी छल ओ छल सरकार के सितम्बर 2025 मे 26 सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म पर प्रतिबंध. सरकार एकरा नियामक उपाय के रूप म॑ फ्रेम करलकै, लेकिन प्रदर्शनकारी क॑ ई बात के विश्वास छेलै कि ई प्रतिबंध के असली कारण नेपाल केरऽ शासक वर्ग केरऽ बच्चा आरू करीबी रिश्तेदारऽ के विशेषाधिकार आरू धन प॑ केंद्रित सोशल मीडिया केरऽ ट्रेंड क॑ रोकै के छै । आर्थिक विभाजन हमेशा स हकीकत रहल छल, मुदा आब पहिल बेर नेपाल क एकटा गरीब बेरोजगार युवा मंत्री क बेटा-बेटी कए इंस्टाग्राम पर एकरा जीबैत देख सकैत छल, एकटा खरीददारी पर जतेक खर्च करैत छल ओहि स बेसी खर्च ओहि युवा कए जीवन भरि मे कमाएबाक आशा भ सकैत छल।

जाबे तक राज्य चिंगारी के संबोधित करय के चक्कर मे आबि जाएत अछि ता धरि आगि पसरि गेल अछि. बांग्लादेश में हसीना वाजेद सुप्रीम कोर्ट सं आरक्षण कोटा घटा क सात प्रतिशत करौलनि मुदा ई बहुत कम, बहुत देर भ गेल; फ्यूज पहिने सं जरि गेल छल आ विरोध निरंकुशता आ सरकारी दमन के दौरान जान-माल के नुकसान के खिलाफ विद्रोह बनि गेल छल. अपन महल मे बैसल कल्पना कयल जाइत अछि जे हसीना केँ बस एतबे नहि बुझल छल जे ओकरा की मारि पड़ल छलैक.

जेकरऽ भविष्यवाणी करना लगभग असंभव छै, वू छै एकल चिंगारी जे विस्फोट क॑ शुरू करी दै छै, अंतिम भूसा जे प्राचीन शासन केरऽ पीठ क॑ तोड़ी दै छै । आरू बहुत बार, वू चिंगारी एतना छोटऽ होय जाय छै कि ई महत्वहीन होय ​​जाय छै आरू सालों-वर्षऽ स॑ जमा होय वाला मौजूदा बोझ के तुलना म॑ भूसा लगभग वजनहीन होय ​​जाय छै ।

नेपाल मे सरकार सोशल मीडिया प्रतिबंध लगेलाक किछुए दिन बाद हटा देलक मुदा ताबत धरि कतेको दर्जन प्रदर्शनकारीक मौत भ गेल छल आ सरकारी भवन मे आगि लागि गेल छल। प्रतिबंध लगला के चारि दिन बाद, आओर एकरा हटाबय के एक दिन बाद प्रधानमंत्री के इस्तीफा देबय पड़लन्हि.

भारत केरऽ ‘कोकरोच’ आन्दोलन एकरऽ तुलना म॑ हल्का छेलै । लेकिन ई खाली परीक्षा लीक पर आक्रोश नै बल्कि संघ के एजेंडा आरू नेटवर्क द्वारा पूरा तरह स॑ कैप्चर करलऽ गेलऽ सिस्टम के साथ गहराई स॑ कुंठा के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छेलै । राज्य क॑ ई आश्चर्य के बावजूद कि समय केरऽ परीक्षण करलऽ गेलऽ भारी-भरकम रणनीति आरू मीडिया केरऽ धब्बा अब॑ काम नै करी रहलऽ नजर आबी रहलऽ छै, ई आन्दोलन के नियंत्रण स॑ बाहर फैलला स॑ पहल॑ केंद्रीय मांग क॑ संबोधित करी क॑ आरू घातक बल के सहारा नै लै क॑ अपनऽ पड़ोसी देशऽ स॑ कहीं अधिक दूरदर्शिता के साथ काम करलकै । आन्दोलन केरऽ अंतिम भाग्य तय करना बाकी छै, लेकिन फिलहाल त॑ लगै छै कि संकट नरेंद्र मोदी केरऽ अखनी तलक अभेद्य कवच केरऽ चिंक उजागर करी क॑ भी बीती गेलऽ छै ।

Read more जखन काज आ फुर्सत फेल भ जाइत अछि त की विरोध शून्यता के भरैत अछि?

प्रायः कोनो आन्दोलन या विरोध पर राज्य केरऽ अति प्रतिक्रिया के कारण वू विरोध विद्रोह आरू क्रांति म॑ गुब्बारा बनी जाय छै भले ही प्रदर्शनकारी केरऽ मूल मंशा वू नै छेलै । केस इन पॉइंट : 9 जनवरी 1905 कए रूढ़िवादी पादरी फादर जॉर्जी गैपोन क नेतृत्व मे किसान मजदूर क पैघ मुदा अधिकतर शांतिपूर्ण जुलूस ।गपोन कोनो क्रांतिकारी नहि छलाह आ ने भीड़ मे क्रान्तिकारी तत्व प्रमुख छलाह । दरअसल, बोल्शेविक सन ज़ार विरोधी दल एहि मार्च कए राजनीतिक मांग क अभाव मे अस्वीकार कएने छल । ज़ार केरऽ आइकन आरू चित्र ल॑ क॑ भीड़ निकोलस द्वितीय क॑ अपनऽ परोपकारी ‘छोटऽ पिता’ मान॑ छेलै जेकरा स॑ हुनका आशा छेलै कि हुनकऽ निहोरा सुनी क॑ शोषण स॑ बचाबै के मौका मिलतै । बल्कि भीड़ पर घबरा गेल शाही सैनिक गोली चला देलक जेकर परिणामस्वरूप सैकड़ों लोकक मौत भ गेल। विचलित आ निराश, मृत आ घायल लोक सं घेरल, पहिने ज़ार समर्थक गैपोन के चिचियाइत सुनल गेल: “आब कोनो भगवान नहिं छथि. कोनो ज़ार नहि अछि।” आ एतय सं साम्राज्यवादी रूसक दिन गिनल गेल.

तखन एतय हमर सबहक राज्य सहित सब राज्यक लेल सबक अछि : चिंता के इलाज सं परे मेटास्टेसाइज होबय सं पहिने संबोधित करू आ सिर्फ एहि लेल जे कोनो रणनीति अतीत में काज केलक अछि एकर कोनो गारंटी नहिं जे वर्तमान में एकर बैकफायर नहिं होयत. अंत मे, जखन स्केलपेल कें आवश्यकता होयत छै तखन कहियो हैकसा कें उपयोग नहि करूं.

ई लेख सबसें पहलऽ १० अगस्त २०२६ क॑ द डेली स्टार केरऽ एएनएन पार्टनर डॉन म॑ “टिक, टिक ... बूम” नाम स॑ प्रकाशित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

description: Ex-Delhi Capitals Star Replaces Rohit Paudel As Nepal's ODI Captain  NDTV Sports

full_article:
Leg-spinner Sandeep Lamichhane, who earlier played for Delhi Capitals, has been named Nepal's new ODI captain by the Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) on Monday. He replaces long-serving skipper Rohit Paudel, as the CAN announced the squad for the ACC Men's Premier Cup, set to be held from August 30 to September 12 in Malaysia. Lamichhane, 26, returns to the leadership role after previously captaining Nepal in 14 ODIs before Paudel assumed the position in late 2022. Lamichhane brings immense international experience to the role, having taken 154 wickets in 77 ODIs so far.

He holds the record for being the fastest Nepalese bowler to reach 150 ODI wickets and is also the first player from his country to cross the 100-wicket mark in T20Is. He takes over the reins from Paudel, who enjoyed a successful tenure at the helm.

Under Paudel's captaincy, Nepal mounted a historic comeback in the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 by winning 11 of their final 12 matches, securing a direct berth in the ODI World Cup Qualifier in Zimbabwe in June 2023. Beyond his tactical leadership, Paudel served as a reliable anchor in the middle order throughout his tenure.

Lamichhane's reappointment marks a key leadership transition for Nepal as they look to build momentum in the 50-over format. In Nepal's squad, there is no place for Kushal Bhurtel, Bhim Sharki, Nandan Yadav or Binod Bhandari. Instead, Sompal Kami and Aarif Sheikh have been included. Dev Khanal, Sher Malla, Sundeep Jora and Basir Ahamad have also been added.

The upcoming tournament will mark the third edition of the Premier Cup and will be played in the 50-over format, mirroring the inaugural 2023 edition that was won by Nepal as the host nation.

title: Climate-induced loss and damage in Nepal: attribution analysis and institutional readiness for international support - Climate Analytics
description: Climate-induced loss and damage in Nepal: attribution analysis and institutional readiness for international support  Climate Analytics
publisher.title: Climate Analytics
full_article: Nepal, a mountainous, landlocked and least developed country in the eastern Himalayas, is highly vulnerable to climate change due to its complex topography, fragile ecosystem and limited ability to adapt to rapidly growing climate impacts. The vulnerability is exacerbated with increased frequency and intensity of climate induced disasters, such as floods, landslides, glacier retreat and glacier lake outburst floods (GLOF), among others, leading to loss and damage. This precipitation in influencing major climate hazards. The results show a significant increase in the frequency and intensity of extreme heat and heavy rainfall events, with some extreme events becoming up to three times more likely due to anthropogenic climate change. To address this and to effectively implement response to loss and damage, the governance system remains important; however, the institutional analysis shows that despite the presence of relatively comprehensive climate-related policies, there is fragmentation and overlapping mandates among national institutions, limitation in data availability and quality, and capacity gaps at multiple levels of governance. For more effective governance responses, the results suggest strengthening climate and weather data systems and instruments, encouraging ex ante physics-based climate attribution studies and enhancing inter-agency coordination that can help Nepal to enhance access to loss and damage finance and eventually expedite implementation of policy and action addressing loss and damage.

title: Nepal PM Balen Shah Meets Indian Envoy Naveen Srivastawa Ahead Of All Others - Deccan Chronicle
description: Nepal PM Balen Shah Meets Indian Envoy Naveen Srivastawa Ahead Of All Others  Deccan Chronicle
publisher.title: Deccan Chronicle
full_article:
New Delhi: Ending his self-imposed rule to not have one-on-one meetings with envoys, Nepal Prime Minister Mr Balen Shah on Monday met the Indian ambassador to Kathmandu, Mr Naveen Srivastawa. He later also met the Chinese ambassador to Kathmandu and will meet the United States Chargé d’Affaires on Tuesday.

This was the first direct diplomatic contact between an Indian envoy and the Nepal PM who had in the past refused to meet any foreign diplomat privately though he met envoys in gatherings. He had refused to meet India’s Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri in May, leading New Delhi to cancel the visit, and had denied separate audiences to high-ranking United States officials, including Assistant Secretary of State Samir Paul Kapur and special envoy Sergio Gor.

However, Mr Shah chose “Shravan Somvar”, an auspicious day in the Hindu calendar, to initiate strategic engagements with his neighbouring countries. In this regard, India was called the first before others even though Mr Shah tried to balance China by calling its envoy Mr Zhang Maoming the same day, but after Mr Srivastava.

The India-first sequencing was significant. A senior foreign ministry official had told a Kathmandu-based daily Nepal Khabar before the meetings, “The Indian ambassador is told to come first, followed by the Chinese ambassador,” adding that the timing reflected the government's foreign-policy priority.

Mr Srivastava conveyed greetings of Indian Prime Minister Mr Narendra Modi to Mr Shah and gifted him a Madhubani painting. Mr Shah’s council of ministers were also present during the meeting held at Singha Durbar.

Taking to social media platform X, following the courtesy call with Mr Shah, ambassador Srivastava said, "I conveyed warm greetings from Prime Minister Modi ji to Prime Minister Balendra Shah and had an engaging and productive exchange of views on further deepening robust, multi-faceted India and Nepal partnership. We had an in-depth and fruitful discussion on further strengthening the robust, multidimensional partnership between India and Nepal .”

Mr Shah’s secretariat also said that various issues of bilateral friendship, mutual interests, development partnership and cooperation between Nepal and India were discussed during the meeting.

title: Science Partnerships for Prosperity: How CIMMYTs Science-Market-Led Collaboration is Transforming Nepal's Maize Economy - cimmyt.org
description: Science Partnerships for Prosperity: How CIMMYTs Science-Market-Led Collaboration is Transforming Nepal's Maize Economy  cimmyt.org
publisher.title: cimmyt.org
full_article:
Photo credit: CIMMYT

Nepal imports hundreds of thousands of tons of maize every year to meet the growing demand of its livestock and feed industries. Yet, the country’s fertile Terai region has enormous, untapped potential to produce high-quality maize, increase rural incomes, and strengthen national food and feed security. The challenge has never been about production alone—it has been about creating a system where farmers, markets, financial institutions, governments, and private businesses work together.

The Scaling for Impact Science Program demonstrates that when these actors are connected through market-led partnerships , smallholder farmers can transition from subsistence production to profitable commercial agriculture.

Disseminating Research Recommendations

The project developed a Spring Maize Best Management Practices (BMP) Technical Bulletin , with several years of maize trial data from CIMMYT and Nepal Agricultural Research Council (NARC). The bulletin was reviewed and endorsed by NARC and co-designed with the Government of Nepal. The technical guidance was widely disseminated through local governments, cooperatives, websites, WhatsApp groups, and social media platforms, reaching approximately 150,000 people .

Knowledge was further strengthened through district-level Training of Trainers (ToT) programs on using BMPs, where 225 cooperative leaders, traders, and local government officials were trained across six districts, creating a network of local experts capable of supporting thousands of maize farmers.

Cooperatives at the Centre of Commercialization

One of the most significant achievements has been placing farmers’ cooperatives at the heart of commercialization.

A total of 86 cooperatives , representing 30,536 farming households (approximately 150,000 individuals), jointly prepared production, aggregation, and marketing plans covering 15,125 hectares of spring maize. Importantly, 65% of participants were women , highlighting the inclusive nature of the approach.

These coordinated production plans translated into impressive outcomes:

108,190 tons of maize produced

Average productivity of 7.15 tons per hectare , more than double the national maize productivity.

Production valued at approximately USD 22.35 million

93% of grain sold commercially

Average household maize income of USD 1,478 , from an otherwise fallow land.

These figures demonstrate that commercial agriculture is not simply about producing more maize—it is about enabling farmers to consistently access profitable markets.

Photo credit: CIMMYT

Strengthening Local Service Delivery

Market-led extension has become another pillar of the initiative.

Twenty-one agro-dealers and fifteen machinery suppliers demonstrated improved seed, soil fertility technologies, irrigation equipment, and mechanization services directly in farming communities, reaching around 150,000 people .

At the same time, agro-dealers supplied 300 tons of farmers’ preferred hybrid maize seed , valued at approximately USD 1 million , across eight districts in eastern and western Nepal.

To address production risks, two roundtable discussions with the Department of Water Resources and Irrigation helped coordinate irrigation during critical crop growth stages across 750 hectares of maize production.

Local Networks Driving Lasting Change

Sustainable scaling depends on local ownership.

The program facilitated the establishment of seven district-level maize commercialization networks , bringing together input suppliers, cooperatives, youth representatives, feed millers, traders, and local governments. Three of these networks are led by women.

These multi-stakeholder platforms have become important mechanisms for sharing information on seed availability, fertilizer, irrigation, mechanization, pest management, and market prices. Their district-level WhatsApp groups now support real-time communication while helping local and provincial governments identify farmers’ needs for inclusion in annual planning and budgeting.

Photo credit: CIMMYT

Linking Farmers Directly to Industry

Perhaps the most transformative aspect of the initiative has been creating direct market linkages.

Photo credit: CIMMYT

Five formal buyback agreements were established between cooperatives and animal feed companies, enabling cooperatives to supply 1,400 tons of maize directly to feed mills . An even more significant milestone was achieved when Gaurishankar Agro Industry Pvt. Ltd. , Nepal’s largest animal feed manufacturer, signed a buyback agreement with a farmers’ cooperative in Sunsari District for 22,500 metric tons of maize , valued at approximately USD 5.25 million .

The partnership extended beyond marketing. Through Gaurishankar Agro Industry’s corporate guarantee, the cooperative secured USD 0.34 million in financing from Laxmi Sunrise Bank , enabling timely access to quality agricultural inputs, working capital for maize farmers.

This integrated model—combining production, guaranteed markets, and finance—reduces farmers’ risks while improving their investment capacity.

Scaling Through Strong Partnerships

The program demonstrates that sustainable agricultural transformation requires collaboration across sectors.

Today, the maize commercialization process actively engages:

25 local governments

28 agricultural input businesses

22 maize traders and MSMEs

10 animal feed companies

Their combined efforts have driven remarkable expansion in spring maize cultivation—from 2,000 hectares in 2025 to 15,125 hectares in 2026 , representing a 650% increase in just one year.

Public investment has also followed. Local and provincial governments invested approximately USD 0.4 million to improve farmers’ access to quality seed, irrigation, and mechanization services.

Photo credit: CIMMYT

A Model Ready for National Scale

The success of the market-led commercialization approach has attracted strong government support.

Recognizing its impact, the Government of Nepal has decided to expand the Maize Commercial Model (MCM) to 10 municipalities across the Terai districts of Morang, Sunsari, Bara, Rautahat, Banke, and Bardiya during FY 2026/27, covering Koshi, Madhesh, and Lumbini Provinces.

Looking Ahead

The experience from Nepal demonstrates that agricultural transformation is driven not by a single technology or intervention, but by strong partnerships that connect science, markets, finance, extension, and policy.

By organizing farmers into commercially oriented cooperatives, linking them with input suppliers and buyers, strengthening local institutions, and enabling public-private collaboration, the program is creating a resilient maize value chain that benefits farmers, businesses, and consumers alike.

नेपाल अपन पशुपालन आ चारा उद्योगक बढ़ैत मांग कें पूरा करय लेल हर साल लाखों टन मक्का आयात करैत अछि. तइयो देश केरऽ उपजाऊ तराई क्षेत्र म॑ उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला मक्का के उत्पादन, ग्रामीण आय बढ़ाबै, आरू राष्ट्रीय खाद्य आरू चारा सुरक्षा क॑ मजबूत करै के अपार, अप्रयुक्त क्षमता छै । चुनौती कहियो केवल उत्पादन के नै रहल छै-ई एकटा एहन व्यवस्था बनाबय के रहल छै जतय किसान, बाजार, वित्तीय संस्थान, सरकार, आ निजी व्यवसाय मिल क काज करय.

स्केलिंग फॉर इम्पैक्ट साइंस प्रोग्राम इ दर्शाबय छै की जखन इ अभिनेताक कें बाजार कें नेतृत्व मे साझेदारी कें माध्यम सं जोड़ल जायत छै , तखन लघु किसानक निर्वाह उत्पादन सं लाभदायक वाणिज्यिक कृषि मे संक्रमण कयर सकय छै.

शोध अनुशंसा के प्रसार

परियोजना एकटा स्प्रिंग मक्का सर्वोत्तम प्रबंधन प्रथा (बीएमपी) तकनीकी बुलेटिन विकसित केलक , जाहि मे सीआईएमवाईटी आ नेपाल कृषि अनुसंधान परिषद (एनएआरसी) सं कई सालक मक्का परीक्षणक आंकड़ा छल. बुलेटिन के समीक्षा आ समर्थन नार्क द्वारा कयल गेल आ नेपाल सरकार के संग सह-निर्माण कयल गेल छल । स्थानीय सरकार, सहकारी, वेबसाइट, व्हाट्सएप समूह, आ सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म कें माध्यम सं तकनीकी मार्गदर्शन कें व्यापक रूप सं प्रसारित कैल गेलय, जे लगभग 150,000 लोगक कें बीच पहुंच गेलय .

बीएमपी कें उपयोग पर जिला स्तरीय प्रशिक्षक कें प्रशिक्षण (टीओटी) कार्यक्रमक कें माध्यम सं ज्ञान कें आ बेसि मजबूत कैल गेलय, जत छह जिलाक मे 225 सहकारी नेताक, व्यापारियक, आ स्थानीय सरकार कें अधिकारियक कें प्रशिक्षित कैल गेलय, जेकरा सं स्थानीय विशेषज्ञक कें एकटा नेटवर्क बनायल गेलय जे हजारक मक्का किसानक कें सहायता करय मे सक्षम छल.

व्यावसायिकरण केन्द्र मे सहकारी संस्था

एकटा महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि रहल अछि किसानक सहकारी कें व्यावसायिकरण कें केंद्र मे राखनाय.

कुल 86 सहकारी , जे 30,536 खेती करय वाला घरक (लगभग 150,000 व्यक्तिक) कें प्रतिनिधित्व करय छै, संयुक्त रूप सं उत्पादन, एकत्रीकरण, आ विपणन योजना तैयार करलकय जे 15,125 हेक्टेयर वसंत मक्का कें कवर करय छै. महत्वपूर्ण बात इ छै की 65% प्रतिभागी महिला छल , जे दृष्टिकोण कें समावेशी प्रकृति कें उजागर करयत छै.

ई समन्वित उत्पादन योजना प्रभावशाली परिणाम मे बदलल:

108,190 टन मक्का के उत्पादन भेल

औसत उत्पादकता 7.15 टन प्रति हेक्टेयर , राष्ट्रीय मक्का उत्पादकता सं दुगुना सं बेसि.

उत्पादन मूल्य लगभग 22.35 मिलियन डॉलर छल

93% अनाज व्यावसायिक रूप स बेचल जाइत अछि

औसत घरेलू मक्का आय USD 1,478 , अन्यथा परती जमीन स।

इ आंकड़ा इ दर्शाबय छै की व्यावसायिक कृषि केवल बेसि मक्का कें उत्पादन कें बारे मे नहि छै-ई किसानक कें लगातार लाभदायक बाजारक मे पहुंचय मे सक्षम बनानाय छै.

फोटो साभार: सीआईएमवाईटी

स्थानीय सेवा प्रदायगी के मजबूत करब

बाजार क नेतृत्व मे विस्तार एहि पहल क एकटा आओर स्तंभ बनि गेल अछि।

इक्कीस कृषि डीलर आ पन्द्रह मशीनरी आपूर्तिकर्ताक कें बेहतर बीज, मिट्टी कें उर्वरता प्रौद्योगिकी, सिंचाई उपकरण, आ मशीनीकरण सेवाक कें प्रदर्शन सीधा किसान समुदायक मे कैल गेलय, जे लगभग 150,000 लोगक तइक पहुंच गेलय.

एकरऽ साथ ही एग्रो-डीलर न॑ पूर्वी आरू पश्चिमी नेपाल केरऽ आठ जिला म॑ किसानऽ के पसंदीदा संकर मक्का के बीज के 300 टन आपूर्ति करलकै, जेकरऽ कीमत लगभग 1 मिलियन डॉलर छेलै ।

उत्पादन कें जोखिम कें संबोधित करय कें लेल जल संसाधन आ सिंचाई विभाग कें साथ दू गोलमेज चर्चा सं 750 हेक्टेयर मक्का उत्पादन मे फसल विकास कें महत्वपूर्ण चरणक कें दौरान सिंचाई कें समन्वय मे मदद मिलल.

स्थानीय नेटवर्क स्थायी परिवर्तन के संचालन

टिकाऊ स्केलिंग स्थानीय स्वामित्व पर निर्भर करैत अछि।

कार्यक्रम मे सात जिला स्तरीय मक्का व्यावसायिकरण नेटवर्क कें स्थापना मे सुविधा भेल , जे इनपुट आपूर्तिकर्ता, सहकारी, युवा प्रतिनिधि, फीड मिलर, व्यापारी, आ स्थानीय सरकारक कें एक साथ लाएल गेलय. एहि मे स तीनटा नेटवर्क क नेतृत्व महिला करैत छथि।

इ बहु-हितधारक प्लेटफार्म बीज उपलब्धता, खाद, सिंचाई, मशीनीकरण, कीट प्रबंधन, आ बाजार मूल्यक कें जानकारी साझा करय कें लेल महत्वपूर्ण तंत्र बइन गेल छै. हुनकऽ जिला स्तरीय व्हाट्सएप समूह अब॑ वास्तविक समय संचार के समर्थन करै छै जबकि स्थानीय आरू प्रांतीय सरकारऽ क॑ वार्षिक योजना आरू बजट म॑ शामिल करै लेली किसानऽ के जरूरतऽ के पहचान करै म॑ मदद करै छै ।

फोटो साभार: सीआईएमवाईटी

किसानों को सीधे उद्योग से जोड़ना

शायद एहि पहल क सबस परिवर्तनकारी पहलू रहल अछि सीधा बाजार स जुड़ाव पैदा करब।

फोटो साभार: सीआईएमवाईटी

सहकारी आ पशु चारा कंपनीक कें बीच पांच औपचारिक वापसी समझौता स्थापित कैल गेलय, जेकरा सं सहकारी संस्थाक कें सीधा फीड मिलक कें 1,400 टन मक्का कें आपूर्ति करय मे सक्षम बनायत छै. एकटा आओर महत्वपूर्ण मील के पत्थर तखन हासिल भेल जखन गौरीशंकर एग्रो इंडस्ट्री प्रा. लिमिटेड , नेपाल के सबस पैघ पशु चारा निर्माता कंपनी सुनसरी जिला के एकटा किसान सहकारी के संग 22,500 मीट्रिक टन मक्का के लेल वापस खरीद समझौता पर हस्ताक्षर केलक , जेकर कीमत लगभग 5.25 मिलियन डॉलर अछि .

साझेदारी मार्केटिंग स आगू बढ़ि गेल। गौरीशंकर एग्रो इंडस्ट्री कें कॉरपोरेट गारंटी कें माध्यम सं सहकारी लक्ष्मी सनराइज बैंक सं 0.34 मिलियन डॉलर कें वित्तपोषण सुरक्षित करलकय , जेकरा सं मक्का किसानक कें लेल कार्यशील पूंजी, गुणवत्तापूर्ण कृषि इनपुट कें समय पर पहुंच संभव भ सकय छै.

इ एकीकृत मॉडल-उत्पादन, गारंटीकृत बाजार आ वित्त कें संयोजन-किसानक कें जोखिम कें कम करयत छै आ ओकर निवेश क्षमता मे सुधार करयत छै.

मजबूत साझेदारी के माध्यम से स्केलिंग

इ कार्यक्रम इ दर्शाबय छै की टिकाऊ कृषि परिवर्तन कें लेल क्षेत्रक मे सहयोग कें आवश्यकता छै.

आइ मक्काक व्यावसायिकरण प्रक्रिया सक्रिय रूप सं निम्नलिखित मे संलग्न अछि:

25 स्थानीय सरकार

28 कृषि इनपुट व्यवसाय

22 मक्का व्यापारी आ एमएसएमई

10 पशु चारा कंपनी

हुनकऽ संयुक्त प्रयास न॑ वसंत मक्का के खेती म॑ उल्लेखनीय विस्तार करलकै-2025 म॑ 2,000 हेक्टेयर स॑ 2026 म॑ 15,125 हेक्टेयर होय गेलै , जे महज एक साल म॑ 650% के बढ़ोत्तरी के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै ।

एकर बाद सार्वजनिक निवेश सेहो भेल अछि। स्थानीय आ प्रांतीय सरकारक किसानक कें गुणवत्तापूर्ण बीज, सिंचाई, आ मशीनीकरण सेवाक कें पहुंच मे सुधार कें लेल लगभग 0.4 मिलियन डॉलर कें निवेश करलकय.

फोटो साभार: सीआईएमवाईटी

राष्ट्रीय स्तर के लिये तैयार एक मॉडल

बाजार के नेतृत्व वाला व्यावसायिकरण दृष्टिकोण के सफलता स॑ सरकारी समर्थन मजबूत होय गेलऽ छै ।

एकरऽ प्रभाव क॑ पहचानी क॑ नेपाल सरकार न॑ वित्तीय वर्ष २०२६/२७ के दौरान तराई जिला मोरङ, सुनसरी, बारा, रौतहट, बाँके, आरू बर्दिया केरऽ १० नगरपालिका म॑ मक्का वाणिज्यिक मॉडल (एमसीएम) क॑ विस्तारित करै के फैसला करलकै, जेकरा म॑ कोशी, मधेश, आरू लुम्बिनी प्रांत शामिल छै ।

आगू देखैत

नेपाल स॑ मिललऽ अनुभव ई दर्शाबै छै कि कृषि परिवर्तन कोनो एक तकनीक या हस्तक्षेप स॑ नै, बल्कि मजबूत साझेदारी स॑ संचालित होय छै जे विज्ञान, बाजार, वित्त, विस्तार, आरू नीति क॑ जोड़ै छै ।

किसानक कें व्यावसायिक रूप सं उन्मुख सहकारी समितियक मे संगठित करयत, ओकरा इनपुट आपूर्तिकर्ताक आ खरीदारक सं जोड़यत, स्थानीय संस्थाक कें मजबूत करयत, आ सार्वजनिक-निजी सहयोग कें सक्षम बनायत, इ कार्यक्रम एकटा लचीला मक्का मूल्य श्रृंखला बना रहल छै जे किसानक, व्यवसायक आ उपभोक्ताअक कें समान रूप सं लाभ पहुंचा रहल छै.

In a significant diplomatic outreach to its immediate neighbours, Indian envoys in Bangladesh and Nepal on Monday separately called on the Prime Ministers of the two countries, conveying Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s greetings and reaffirming New Delhi’s commitment to strengthening bilateral ties. title: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified - News On AIR
description: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified  News On AIR
publisher.title: News On AIR
full_article:
India has rejected Nepal’s claim over Lipulekh Pass, termed it as a long-standing route for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra since 1954 and the Yatra through this route has been going on for decades. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal in a social media post said this in response to claims related to border issues made by Foreign Ministry of Nepal in the context of the annual Kailash Manasarovar Yatra.

He stressed that India’s position in this regard had been consistent and clear and this is not a new development. Mr Jaiswal pointed out that India has consistently maintained that such claims are neither justified nor based on historical facts and evidence. He stressed that such unilateral artificial enlargement of territorial claims is untenable. The spokesperson added that India remains open to a constructive interaction with Nepal on all issues in the bilateral relationship, including on resolving agreed outstanding boundary issues through dialogue and diplomacy.

title: Bharat–Nepal Kin-State Paradigm - Khabarhub
description: Bharat–Nepal Kin-State Paradigm  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
Nepal is at a crossroads, shifting its geopolitical position. Nepal claims to be a “vibrant bridge” rather than a buffer state between the two giants, but after the Gen-Z movement, it turned into a superpower vassal state, creating an existential crisis. This was demonstrated during the backdoor visit of the Prime Minister’s adviser to Delhi.

The bridge concept is the outcome of a Cold War mentality, choosing a balancing policy rather than bandwagoning. Nepal’s superiority complex (arising from an inferiority complex) did not accept the bandwagoning policy of following dominant powers’ rules in exchange for security or rewards. Nepal instead took the opposite extreme of balancing, inviting other states (China) to counter-push and restore equilibrium.

The resistance to giants such as the USA, China, and India by small states like Nepal in the 21st century has not only proved counterproductive but has also created an existential crisis. Nepal cannot afford to fully balance by inviting China against India, nor can it fully bandwagon with a superpower, with America as the dominant power. Rather, experts propose a hedging policy that cultivates economic ties with one giant while maintaining security ties with another.

Nepali public intellectual and leader Buddha Tsering Moktan advocates for a “kin-state diplomacy” between India and Nepal. This vision moves beyond traditional realist methods toward a civilizational paradigm. The power of kinship politics goes beyond the limitations of modern sovereignty, thereby restoring Nepal’s historical role as a custodian of civilizational relations between the Indic and Sinic civilizations in the 21st century.

Civilizational consciousness

Moktan critiques the Westphalian paradigm that underpins modern statehood. Following thinkers such as K.M. Panikkar and Ashis Nandy, he argues that South Asian political boundaries are colonial legacies that dismantled a historically integrated civilizational continuum.

Moktan’s vision offers a path forward in a fragmented global order where political community begins with cultural intimacy. The Himalayas, long imagined as barriers, may yet reemerge as bridges of moral and civilizational renewal.

India and Nepal are separated by modern political borders but inherently linked by an Indic civilizational philosophy and spirituality. According to Moktan, this represents a “civilizational turn” in international relations theory, in line with Samuel Huntington, Shmuel Eisenstadt, and Tu Weiming, yet departing from them by rejecting civilizational clash in favor of civilizational symbiosis.

For Moktan, kinship is not a tool of soft power; it is the ontological basis of political relations itself.

Indic model of kin-state diplomacy

Moktan asserts that sovereignty and kinship are not mutually exclusive, especially in relation to “civilizational sibling” states such as Nepal and India. This relational paradigm draws upon the Indic philosophical concepts of dharma (moral order) and sahajata (natural affinity).

This framework of political engagement reflects the moral continuity of civilization rather than the transactional calculus of statecraft. India’s foreign policy toward Nepal must shift from hegemonic paternalism to fraternal partnership, and Nepal must embrace its role as a bridge state that embodies a shared cultural heritage.

This civilization-based “kin-state diplomacy” seeks to affirm historical belonging while safeguarding modern autonomy. Moktan fuses Rabindranath Tagore’s cosmopolitan universalism with Kautilya’s pragmatic realism, producing “dharmic realism,” in which the art of statecraft becomes a moral obligation rather than a strategic vulnerability.

Civilizational bridge

Throughout history, the Licchhavi (c. 450–750 CE) and Malla (c. 1200–1779 CE) dynasties successfully served as a civilizational bridge. The political and cultural heart of these eras mediated and transmitted languages, art, religious ideas, and commerce between Indic and Sinic cultures.

For example, Pratap Malla (1641–1674 CE) minted silver coins for Tibet, negotiated commercial privileges, and maintained embassies that engaged both Mughal India and the Qing sphere.

Throughout history, China and India were undisputed hyper-economies, together accounting for over half of the world’s GDP. Nepal was neither a peripheral frontier nor a passive recipient of influence; rather, it was a civilizational conduit, actively shaping ideas.

History legitimizes Moktan’s claim that Nepal is not a buffer state caught between powers, but a kin-state that integrates two great civilizations. After 1950, anti-Indian rhetoric became intertwined with Nepali nationalism.

Kin-state models

Moktan’s vision resonates with several global analogues of cultural kinship in interstate relationships.

The Nordic Council (1952) demonstrates kin-state solidarity, where Denmark, Norway, and Sweden operate on the basis of cultural kinship, shared historical consciousness, and political cooperation without dissolving sovereignty.

Pan-Arabism persists through linguistic and cultural kinship despite state rivalries.

Pan-Africanism, by contrast, has succeeded primarily as a moral framework emphasizing shared identity, anti-colonialism, and mutual aid.

Right-wing populist movements are actively advocating a pan-European “White, Christian Europe” and are shifting from nation-state nationalism toward civilizational populism. They frame Europe not as a bureaucratic union of markets (the EU), but as an exclusive ancestral fortress rooted in an ethno-cultural matrix of White and Judeo-Christian identity.

Moktan’s model also echoes the ancient Chinese interconnected matrix of Tianxia (All Under Heaven), Sanjiao (the Three Teachings—Buddhism for inner peace and the afterlife, Confucianism for the social mind, and Taoism/Daoism for the cosmic soul), and Sanjie (the Three Worlds), imagining a moral order that integrated diversity through cultural virtue and shaped East Asia.

Nepal as a civilizational mediator

In the 21st century, Moktan envisions Nepal renewing its historical role as a mediating civilization. Situated between rising global powers, Nepal can model civilizational pluralism and ethical sovereignty, asserting independence not through isolation but through service as a cultural and moral interlocutor between Bharata and Zhongguo.

Moktan’s kin-state paradigm transforms Nepal–Bharat relations into a civilizational dialogue grounded in shared memory, mutual respect, and ethical interdependence. Reinterpreting history through a moral lens, Moktan positions Nepal not as a small state surviving in the shadow of great powers, but as a custodian of civilizational balance in South Asia.

Moktan’s vision offers a path forward in a fragmented global order where political community begins with cultural intimacy. The Himalayas, long imagined as barriers, may yet reemerge as bridges of moral and civilizational renewal.

नेपाल अपन भूराजनीतिक स्थिति बदलैत चौराहा पर अछि । नेपाल दुनू दिग्गज के बीच बफर राज्य के बजाय “जीवंत पुल” होय के दावा करै छै, लेकिन जेन-जेड आन्दोलन के बाद ई महाशक्ति वसीयत राज्य में बदली गेलै, जेकरा स॑ अस्तित्व संकट पैदा होय गेलै । एकरऽ प्रदर्शन प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ सलाहकार केरऽ दिल्ली केरऽ बैकडोर यात्रा के दौरान करलऽ गेलै ।

पुल के अवधारणा शीत युद्ध के मानसिकता के परिणाम छै, जे बैंडवागनिंग के बजाय संतुलन नीति चुनै छै. नेपाल केरऽ श्रेष्ठता परिसर (हीनता परिसर स॑ उत्पन्न) सुरक्षा या पुरस्कार के बदला म॑ दबंग शक्ति केरऽ नियम के पालन करै के बैंडवाजिंग नीति क॑ स्वीकार नै करलकै । नेपाल एकर बदला मे संतुलन बनेबाक विपरीत चरम पर चलि गेल, अन्य राज्य (चीन) कए प्रति-धक्का आ संतुलन बहाल करबा लेल आमंत्रित केलक ।

21वीं सदी में नेपाल जैसनऽ छोटऽ राज्यऽ द्वारा अमेरिका, चीन, आरू भारत जैसनऽ दिग्गज कंपनी के प्रति प्रतिरोध न सिर्फ प्रतिकूल साबित होय गेलऽ छै बल्कि अस्तित्व के संकट भी पैदा करी देल॑ छै । नेपाल चीन क॑ भारत के खिलाफ आमंत्रित करी क॑ पूरा संतुलन बनाबै के सामर्थ्य नै रखै छै, आरू नै ही वू एगो महाशक्ति के साथ पूरा तरह स॑ बैंडवागन करी सकै छै, जेकरा म॑ अमेरिका क॑ दबंग शक्ति छै । बल्कि विशेषज्ञ हेजिंग नीति के प्रस्ताव रखै छै जे एक दिग्गज कंपनी के साथ आर्थिक संबंध के खेती करै छै जबकि दोसरऽ दिग्गज कंपनी के साथ सुरक्षा संबंध कायम रखै छै ।

नेपाली जनबुद्धिजीवी आ नेता बुद्ध त्सेरिंग मोक्तान भारत आ नेपालक बीच “किं-स्टेट डिप्लोमेसी” केर वकालत करैत छथि । ई दृष्टि पारंपरिक यथार्थवादी पद्धति स॑ आगू बढ़ी क॑ सभ्यता के प्रतिमान के तरफ बढ़ी जाय छै । रिश्तेदारी राजनीति के शक्ति आधुनिक संप्रभुता के सीमा स॑ आगू बढ़ी जाय छै, जेकरा स॑ 21वीं सदी म॑ भारतीय आरू सिनिक सभ्यता के बीच सभ्यता संबंध के संरक्षक के रूप म॑ नेपाल के ऐतिहासिक भूमिका बहाल होय जाय छै ।

सभ्यता के चेतना

मोक्तान वेस्टफेलियन प्रतिमान के आलोचना करै छै जे आधुनिक राज्य के आधार छै । अनुयायी विचारक जेना के.एम. पणिक्कर आरू आशीस नंदी, हुनकऽ तर्क छै कि दक्षिण एशियाई राजनीतिक सीमा औपनिवेशिक विरासत छेकै जे ऐतिहासिक रूप स॑ एकीकृत सभ्यता के निरंतरता क॑ भंग करी देलकै ।

मोक्तान केरऽ दृष्टि एगो खंडित वैश्विक व्यवस्था म॑ आगू के रास्ता पेश करै छै, जहां राजनीतिक समुदाय केरऽ शुरुआत सांस्कृतिक अंतरंगता स॑ होय छै । बहुत दिन स बाधा क रूप मे कल्पना कैल गेल हिमालय एखनो नैतिक आ सभ्यता क नवीकरण क सेतु क रूप मे फेर स उभर सकैत अछि ।

भारत आ नेपाल आधुनिक राजनीतिक सीमा स अलग अछि मुदा स्वाभाविक रूप स एकटा भारतीय सभ्यता दर्शन आ अध्यात्म स जुड़ल अछि । मोक्तान के अनुसार, ई अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंध सिद्धांत म॑ एगो “सभ्यतावादी मोड़” के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै, जे सैमुअल हंटिंगटन, श्मुएल आइज़नस्टैड, आरू तू वेइमिंग के अनुरूप छै, तभियो सभ्यता के सहजीवन के पक्ष म॑ सभ्यता के टक्कर क॑ नकारतें हुअ॑ ओकरा स॑ हटै छै ।

मोक्तान के लेलऽ रिश्तेदारी कोमल शक्ति के औजार नै छै; ई स्वयं राजनीतिक संबंधक ओंटोलॉजिकल आधार थिक |

रिश्तेदार राज्य कूटनीति के भारतीय मॉडल

मोक्तान केरऽ दावा छै कि संप्रभुता आरू रिश्तेदारी परस्पर विरोधी नै छै, खास करी क॑ नेपाल आरू भारत जैसनऽ “सभ्यतावादी भाई-बहिन” राज्यऽ के संबंध म॑ । ई संबंधात्मक प्रतिमान धर्म (नैतिक क्रम) आरू सहजता (प्राकृतिक आत्मीयता) के भारतीय दार्शनिक अवधारणा के आकर्षित करै छै ।

राजनीतिक जुड़ाव के ई ढाँचा राज्यकला के लेनदेन के गणना के बजाय सभ्यता के नैतिक निरंतरता के दर्शाबै छै. नेपाल के प्रति भारत केरऽ विदेश नीति क॑ वर्चस्ववादी पितृसत्तात्मकता स॑ भ्रातृत्व साझेदारी म॑ बदलना चाहियऽ, आरू नेपाल क॑ साझा सांस्कृतिक धरोहर क॑ समाहित करै वाला सेतु राज्य के रूप म॑ अपनऽ भूमिका क॑ अपनाना चाहियऽ ।

सभ्यता आधारित ई “किं-स्टेट डिप्लोमेसी” आधुनिक स्वायत्तता के रक्षा के साथ-साथ ऐतिहासिक संबंध के पुष्टि करै के कोशिश करै छै । मोक्तान रवीन्द्रनाथ टैगोर केरऽ कॉस्मोपॉलिटन यूनिवर्सलिज्म क॑ कौटिल्य केरऽ व्यावहारिक यथार्थवाद के साथ मिलाबै छै, जेकरा स॑ “धर्मिक यथार्थवाद” पैदा होय छै, जेकरा म॑ राज्यशिल्प केरऽ कला सामरिक कमजोरी के बजाय नैतिक दायित्व बनी जाय छै ।

सभ्यता के पुल

इतिहास भरि मे लिच्छवी (लगभग 450-750 ई.) आ मल्ल (लगभग 1200-1779 ई.) राजवंश सभ्यताक सेतुक रूप मे सफलतापूर्वक काज केलक । ई युगऽ के राजनीतिक आरू सांस्कृतिक हृदय भारतीय आरू सिनिक संस्कृति के बीच भाषा, कला, धार्मिक विचार, आरू वाणिज्य के मध्यस्थता आरू संचरण करलकै ।

जेना कि प्रताप मल्ला (1641-1674 ई.) तिब्बत के लेल चांदी के सिक्का के टकसाल केलनि, व्यावसायिक विशेषाधिकार के बातचीत केलनि आ दूतावास के रखरखाव केलनि जे मुगल भारत आ किंग क्षेत्र दुनू के संलग्न करैत छल.

इतिहास भर म॑ चीन आरू भारत निर्विवाद अति-अर्थव्यवस्था छेलै, जेकरा म॑ मिल क॑ दुनिया केरऽ सकल घरेलू उत्पाद के आधा स॑ भी अधिक हिस्सा छेलै । नेपाल ने परिधीय सीमा छल आ ने प्रभावक निष्क्रिय प्राप्तकर्ता; बल्कि ई सभ्यताक नाली छल, जे सक्रिय रूप सँ विचार केँ आकार दैत छल |

इतिहास मोक्तान केरऽ ई दावा क॑ वैध बनाबै छै कि नेपाल शक्ति के बीच फंसलऽ बफर राज्य नै छै, बल्कि दू महान सभ्यता क॑ एकीकृत करै वाला रिश्तेदार राज्य छेकै । १९५० के बाद भारतविरोधी बयानबाजी नेपाली राष्ट्रवाद के साथ गुंथल गेल ।

किन-स्टेट मॉडल

मोक्तान केरऽ दृष्टि अंतरराज्यीय संबंधऽ म॑ सांस्कृतिक रिश्तेदारी केरऽ कई वैश्विक एनालॉग के साथ गुंजायमान होय छै ।

नॉर्डिक काउंसिल (1952) रिश्तेदार-राज्य एकजुटता के प्रदर्शन करै छै, जहां डेनमार्क, नॉर्वे आरू स्वीडन संप्रभुता क॑ भंग नै करी क॑ सांस्कृतिक रिश्तेदारी, साझा ऐतिहासिक चेतना आरू राजनीतिक सहयोग के आधार प॑ काम करै छै ।

राज्य प्रतिद्वंद्विता के बावजूद भाषाई आरू सांस्कृतिक रिश्तेदारी के माध्यम स॑ पैन-अरबवाद कायम छै ।

एकरऽ विपरीत पैन-अफ्रीकनवाद मुख्य रूप स॑ एगो नैतिक रूपरेखा के रूप म॑ सफल रहलऽ छै जेकरा म॑ साझा पहचान, उपनिवेशवाद विरोधी, आरू आपसी सहायता प॑ जोर देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

दक्षिणपंथी लोकलुभावन आन्दोलन सक्रिय रूप स॑ एक पैन-यूरोपीय “गोरा, ईसाई यूरोप” के वकालत करी रहलऽ छै आरू राष्ट्र-राज्य राष्ट्रवाद स॑ सभ्यतावादी लोकवाद के तरफ बढ़ी रहलऽ छै । ई सब यूरोप क॑ बाजारऽ के नौकरशाही संघ (ईयू) के रूप म॑ नै, बल्कि गोरा आरू जूडियो-ईसाई पहचान के नृवंश-सांस्कृतिक मैट्रिक्स म॑ जड़ जमाय क॑ एक अनन्य पैतृक किला के रूप म॑ फ्रेम करै छै ।

मोक्तान केरऽ मॉडल तियानक्सिया (ऑल अंडर हेवन), संजियाओ (तीन शिक्षा-आन्तरिक शांति आरू परलोक लेली बौद्ध धर्म, सामाजिक मन लेली कन्फ्यूशियसवाद, आरू ब्रह्मांडीय आत्मा लेली ताओवाद/दाओवाद), आरू संजी (तीन दुनिया) केरऽ प्राचीन चीनी परस्पर जुडलऽ मैट्रिक्स के भी प्रतिध्वनित करै छै, जेकरा म॑ सांस्कृतिक के माध्यम स॑ विविधता क॑ एकीकृत करै वाला नैतिक व्यवस्था के कल्पना करलऽ गेलऽ छै गुण आ पूर्वी एशिया के आकार देलक।

सभ्यता मध्यस्थ के रूप मे नेपाल

२१म शताब्दीमे मोक्तान नेपालकेँ मध्यस्थ सभ्यताक रूपमे अपन ऐतिहासिक भूमिकाकेँ नवीनीकरण करबाक परिकल्पना कएल गेल अछि । उभरैत वैश्विक शक्ति के बीच स्थित नेपाल सभ्यता बहुलवाद आ नैतिक संप्रभुता के मॉडल बना सकैत अछि, अलगाव के माध्यम स नै बल्कि भरत आ झोंगगुओ के बीच सांस्कृतिक आ नैतिक वार्ताकार के रूप में सेवा के माध्यम स स्वतंत्रता के पुष्टि क सकैत अछि |

मोक्तान केरऽ रिश्तेदार राज्य प्रतिमान नेपाल-भारत संबंध क॑ साझा स्मृति, आपसी सम्मान, आरू नैतिक परस्पर निर्भरता प॑ आधारित सभ्यता संवाद म॑ बदली दै छै । नैतिक चश्मा स इतिहास क पुनर्व्याख्या करैत मोक्तान नेपाल कए महाशक्ति क छाया मे जीवित छोट राज्य क रूप मे नहि, बल्कि दक्षिण एशिया मे सभ्यता संतुलन क संरक्षक क रूप मे ठाढ़ करैत छथि ।

मोक्तान केरऽ दृष्टि एगो खंडित वैश्विक व्यवस्था म॑ आगू के रास्ता पेश करै छै, जहां राजनीतिक समुदाय केरऽ शुरुआत सांस्कृतिक अंतरंगता स॑ होय छै । बहुत दिन स बाधा क रूप मे कल्पना कैल गेल हिमालय एखनो नैतिक आ सभ्यता क नवीकरण क सेतु क रूप मे फेर स उभर सकैत अछि ।

full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, Aug. 11: Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle has urged multinational companies operating in Nepal to increase investment, expand existing industries, introduce new technologies and create more jobs, assuring them of the government’s support and protection for investments.

During the meeting with representatives of largest taxpayers' multinational companies in Nepal on Monday at the Ministry of Finance, Finance Minister Dr. Wagle said that government’s priority was not merely to increase tax collection but to accelerate the cycle of production, investment, profit and reinvestment.

He said that the government views the private sector not with suspicion, but with the perspective of a partner as the success of the private sector is the foundation of Nepal's economic success.

He said that businessmen are not just profit-making representatives but also the country's largest taxpayers, employers and leading investors.

“When industries make profits, those profits are reinvested, which increases production and creates jobs. Increased employment raises incomes, expands markets and ultimately increases government revenue,” he said.

He said that the relationship between government and the private sector is not a zero-sum relationship. “The success of both is linked to the success of each other.”

“The government's primary responsibility is to protect legitimate investments, assets created, and profits earned in Nepal. Entrepreneurs must be able to trust that their assets are safe, that the rules are stable, that the tax system is predictable, and that the state stands as their partner," he said. “Without building that trust, big investments will not come. Without building that trust, industries will not expand. Without building that trust, economic transformation will not be possible. So today, I want to make a clear appeal to you.”

The minister sought concrete suggestions in areas requiring immediate reform, including tax administration, regulation, land, energy, labour, infrastructure, finance, exports, legal provisions and government procedures.

He assured that the concerned ministries would coordinate within a specified timeframe to implement the issues raised at the meeting, while the Ministry of Finance would continuously monitor progress through a response desk.

Responding to the minister's call, representatives of the companies said they were moving ahead with plans to invest around Rs. 200 billion in Nepal in the near future if there was greater policy stability.

According to Minister Wagle’s secretariat, senior company officials informed the minister that they were advancing investment expansion plans in various projects in productive sectors, including hydropower, paint manufacturing, hotels and beverages.

“We are investing Rs. 200 billion in industries such as hydropower, foods, hotels and paints,” the representatives of the multinational companies said. “The government should create a conducive environment, and we are ready to expand our investments. This will contribute to both employment generation and economic growth.”

The company representatives said the budget introduced by the new government had significantly boosted the confidence of foreign investors. However, they urged the government to be more flexible on certain policy and practical issues.

“With the formation of the new government, improvements have been seen in the administrative operations of the Department of Industry, Office of the Company Registrar, tax offices and customs offices,” they said.

“However, further facilitation is needed in some areas of policy announcements and their practical implementation.”

According to the representatives, the government should facilitate companies operating in Nepal in bringing capital from their parent companies.

They said the government should also facilitate stable customs rates on the import of raw materials by multinational companies, access to locally available raw materials and price regulation, removal of land ownership ceilings, and the harmonisation of tax determination by local governments.

The representatives urged Minister Wagle to eliminate the hassles associated with double taxation and simplify the process for repatriating returns from investments.

Representatives from multinational companies, including Surya Nepal Pvt. Ltd, Ncell Axiata Limited, Aarti Strips Pvt. Ltd, Gorkha Brewery Pvt. Ltd, Himalaya Airlines Pvt. Ltd, Hongshi Shivam Cement Pvt. Ltd, Doosan Enerbility Company Limited and Dabur Nepal Pvt. Ltd attended the meeting.

Similarly, representatives from Bottlers Nepal (Tarai) Limited, Unilever Nepal Limited, Asian Paints (Nepal) Pvt. Ltd., Power Construction Corporation of China Ltd., Gorkha Lahari Pvt. Ltd., Huaxin Cement Narayani Pvt. Ltd., New Hope Agro Business Nepal Pvt. Ltd., Nepal Wellhope Agri-Tech Pvt. Ltd., Varun Beverages Nepal Pvt. Ltd., Turkish Airlines Incorporation Pvt. Ltd., Bhotekoshi Power Company Pvt. Ltd. and Berger Jenson & Nicholson (Nepal) Pvt. Ltd. also attended the meeting.

एक स्टाफ रिपोर्टर, काठमांडू, 11 अगस्त : वित्त मंत्री डॉ. स्वर्णिम वागले नेपाल मे संचालित बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनी सब स निवेश बढ़ाबय, मौजूदा उद्योग के विस्तार करय, नव तकनीक के शुरूआत करय आ बेसी रोजगार के सृजन करय लेल आग्रह केलखिन्ह, जाहि सं हुनका सब के निवेश के लेल सरकार के सहयोग आ सुरक्षा के आश्वासन देल गेल अछि.

सोमदिन वित्त मन्त्रालयमे नेपालक सबसँ पैघ करदाता बहुराष्ट्रीय कम्पनीक प्रतिनिधिसभक बैसारक क्रममे वित्त मन्त्री डा. वागले सरकारके प्राथमिकता मात्र कर वसूली बढेके नहि अपितु उत्पादन, निवेश, लाभ आ पुनर्निवेशके चक्रमे गति देब रहल बतौलनि ।

ओ कहलनि जे, सरकार निजी क्षेत्र के शंका सं नहि, बल्कि एकटा साझेदार के परिप्रेक्ष्य सं देखैत अछि, किया कि निजी क्षेत्र के सफलता नेपाल के आर्थिक सफलता के आधार अछि।

ओ कहला जे व्यवसायी सिर्फ मुनाफा कमाए वाला प्रतिनिधि नहि अछि बल्कि देश क सबस पैघ करदाता, नियोक्ता आ अग्रणी निवेशक सेहो छथि।

ओ कहला जे जखन उद्योग मुनाफा कमबैत अछि त ओहि मुनाफा कए फेर स निवेश कैल जाइत अछि, जाहि स उत्पादन बढ़ैत अछि आ रोजगार क सृजन होइत अछि, रोजगार बढ़ला स आमदनी बढ़ैत अछि, बाजार क विस्तार होइत अछि आ अंततः सरकारी राजस्व मे वृद्धि होइत अछि।

ओ कहला जे सरकार आ निजी क्षेत्र क संबंध शून्य योग क संबंध नहि अछि। “दुनू के सफलता एक दोसरा के सफलता स जुड़ल अछि।”

ओ कहलनि जे, सरकार के प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी नेपाल मे वैध निवेश, निर्मित संपत्ति, आ अर्जित मुनाफा के रक्षा करब अछि, उद्यमी के ई भरोसा करय मे सक्षम हेबाक चाही जे हुनकर संपत्ति सुरक्षित अछि, नियम स्थिर अछि, कर व्यवस्था पूर्वानुमानित अछि, आ राज्य हुनकर भागीदार के रूप मे ठाढ़ अछि। “ओहि विश्वास के बिना बनौने पैघ निवेश नहि आओत। ओहि विश्वास के बिना बनौने उद्योग के विस्तार नहि होयत। ओहि विश्वास के बिना बनौने आर्थिक परिवर्तन संभव नहि होयत। ताहि लेल आई हम अहाँ सब स एकटा स्पष्ट अपील करय चाहैत छी।”

मंत्री कर प्रशासन, नियमन, भूमि, ऊर्जा, श्रम, बुनियादी ढांचा, वित्त, निर्यात, कानूनी प्रावधान आ सरकारी प्रक्रिया सहित तत्काल सुधार क जरूरत वाला क्षेत्र मे ठोस सुझाव मंगलथि।

ओ आश्वासन देलनि जे बैसार मे उठल मुद्दा कए लागू करबा लेल संबंधित मंत्रालय निर्धारित समय सीमा मे समन्वय करत, जखन कि वित्त मंत्रालय प्रतिक्रिया डेस्क क माध्यम स लगातार प्रगति क निगरानी करत।

मंत्री क आह्वान क जवाब दैत कंपनी क प्रतिनिधि कहला जे ओ करीब 100 टका क निवेश क योजना कए आगू बढ़ा रहल अछि। नेपाल मे 200 अरब के निकट भविष्य मे अगर नीतिगत स्थिरता बेसी रहैत त।

मंत्री वागले केरऽ सचिवालय के अनुसार कंपनी केरऽ वरिष्ठ अधिकारी न॑ मंत्री क॑ सूचित करलकै कि हुनी जलविद्युत, पेंट निर्माण, होटल आरू पेय पदार्थ सहित उत्पादक क्षेत्रऽ म॑ विभिन्न परियोजना म॑ निवेश विस्तार योजना क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै छै ।

बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनी क प्रतिनिधि कहला जे हम जलविद्युत, खाद्य पदार्थ, होटल आ पेंट जेहन उद्योग मे 200 अरब टका क निवेश क रहल छी। ओ कहला जे सरकार कए अनुकूल माहौल बनेबाक चाही, आ हम सब अपन निवेश कए विस्तार देबा लेल तैयार छी, एहि स रोजगार पैदा आ आर्थिक विकास दुनू मे योगदान होएत।”

कंपनी के प्रतिनिधि के कहनाय छनि जे नव सरकार के तरफ सं पेश बजट सं विदेशी निवेशक के विश्वास मे काफी बढ़ोतरी भेल अछि. ओना ओ सरकार स आग्रह केलथि जे ओ किछु नीति आ व्यावहारिक मुद्दा पर बेसी लचीलापन करथि।

ओ सब कहलनि जे, नव सरकार के गठन के संग उद्योग विभाग, कंपनी रजिस्ट्रार के कार्यालय, कर कार्यालय आ सीमा शुल्क कार्यालय के प्रशासनिक संचालन में सुधार देखल गेल अछि।

“हालांकि नीतिगत घोषणा आरू ओकरऽ व्यावहारिक कार्यान्वयन के कुछ क्षेत्रऽ म॑ आरू सुविधा के जरूरत छै ।”

प्रतिनिधिसबके अनुसार सरकार नेपालमे संचालित कम्पनीके अपन मूल कम्पनीसँ पूँजी आनबामे सुविधा देबाक चाही ।

ओ सब कहलनि जे, सरकार के बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनी द्वारा कच्चा माल के आयात पर स्थिर सीमा शुल्क दर, स्थानीय रूप सं उपलब्ध कच्चा माल तक पहुंच आ मूल्य नियमन, जमीन के मालिकाना हक के सीमा हटाबय, आ स्थानीय सरकार द्वारा कर निर्धारण के सामंजस्य के सेहो सुविधा देबाक चाही।

प्रतिनिधि सब मंत्री वागल स आग्रह केलथि जे ओ दोहरा कर स जुड़ल परेशानी कए दूर करि निवेश स रिटर्न वापस करबाक प्रक्रिया कए सरल बनाबथि।

सूर्य नेपाल प्रा.लि. लिमिटेड, एनसेल एक्सियाटा लिमिटेड, आरती स्ट्रिप्स प्रा. लिमिटेड, गोरखा ब्रूअरी प्रा. लिमिटेड, हिमालय एयरलाइंस प्रा. लिमिटेड, होंगशी शिवम सीमेंट प्रा. लिमिटेड, दूसन एनर्बिलिटी कम्पनी लिमिटेड तथा डाबर नेपाल प्रा. लिमिटेड बैसार मे भाग लेलक।

तहिना बटलर्स नेपाल (तराई) लिमिटेड, यूनिलिवर नेपाल लिमिटेड, एशियन पेंट्स (नेपाल) प्रा. लिमिटेड, पावर कंस्ट्रक्शन कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ चाइना लिमिटेड, गोरखा लहरी प्रा. लिमिटेड, हुअक्सिन सीमेंट नारायणी प्रा. लिमिटेड, न्यू होप एग्रो बिजनेस नेपाल प्रा. लि., नेपाल वेलहोप एग्री-टेक प्रा. लिमिटेड, वरुण पेय नेपाल प्रा. लिमिटेड, तुर्की एयरलाइंस निगमन प्रा. लिमिटेड, भोटेकोशी पावर कम्पनी प्रा. लिमिटेड एवं बर्गर जेन्सन एंड निकोलसन (नेपाल) प्रा. लिमिटेड सेहो बैसार मे भाग लेलक।

The bodies were found at an altitude of 5,400 meters (17,717 feet) in the Rolwaling region, according to Dreamers Destination Treks and Expedition.

The climbers, three foreigners and two Nepalis, went missing last November after an avalanche struck their group. Two other team members were previously found dead, while five were rescued alive.

The deceased were identified as Marco Di Marcello of Canada, Markus Kirchler of Italy, Jakob Schreiber of Germany, and Nepalis Padam Tamang and Mere Karki.

Phurba Tenjing Sherpa, a rescuer and chief operating officer of Dreamers’ Dream Expedition, said that the bodies of the foreign climbers will be handed over to their families after autopsies are completed in Kathmandu.

Earlier, Qazinform News Agency reported that four climbers were found dead in the Broad Peak avalanche in Pakistan, with six still missing.

full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, Aug. 11: The Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) on Monday appointed Sandeep Lamichhane as the new One Day International (ODI) captain while announcing a 14-member squad for the upcoming ACC Men’s Premier Cup in Malaysia.

Leg-spinner Lamichhane returns to lead the ODI side after a four-year hiatus, succeeding Rohit Paudel ahead of the tournament scheduled for 30 August to 12 September.

"Sandeep Lamichhane has been selected as the Nepali national cricket team's One Day captain effective from the upcoming ACC Premier Cup," CAN said in an official statement.

The appointment formally ends Paudel’s tenure as ODI captain, reflecting CAN’s decision to split format leadership. All-rounder Dipendra Singh Airee was named Twenty20 International skipper a few months ago.

Paudel originally assumed the captaincy in November 2022 following Lamichhane’s suspension amidst legal proceedings.

His final match as captain came against Scotland in the ICC World Cup League 2 series in the Netherlands last month.

Under Paudel’s leadership, Nepal achieved notable success, qualifying for the One Day World Cup Qualifier, the Asia Cup, and two editions of the T20 World Cup. He led the side in 63 ODIs, recording 31 victories and 30 defeats.

Lamichhane, who first captained the national team in 2021, reclaims the role despite a recent dip in form during Nepal’s World Cup League 2 campaign, where he was dropped in last match after going wicketless in three consecutive matches.

Alongside the leadership change, national selectors have made four adjustments to the ODI squad. Regular opener Kushal Bhurtel, veteran pace bowler Sompal Kami, and middle-order batter Aarif Sheikh have been dropped, whilst all-rounder Nandan Yadav misses out through injury. Sundeep Jora, Dev Khanal, Basir Ahamad, and Sher Malla have been recalled to complete the 14-man roster.

In other administrative developments, CAN confirmed that a Nepal ‘A’ side, captained by Anil Sah, will compete in the Northern Territory (NT) Top End T20 Series in Darwin, Australia, from 21 to 30 August.

Furthermore, the squad for the upcoming 20th Asian Games has been finalized following the release of the official participant roster by the National Sports Council.

Declared Squads

Nepal ODI Squad: Sandeep Lamichhane (C), Aasif Sheikh, Arjun Kumal, Rohit Paudel, Dev Khanal, Dipendra Singh Airee, Sundeep Jora, Basir Ahamad, Ishan Pandey, Gulsan Jha, Sher Malla, Lalit Rajbanshi, Karan KC, Hemant Dhami.

Nepal ‘A’ Squad (Top End T20 Series): Anil Kumar Sah (C), Trit Raj Das, Mayan Yadav, Kushal Bhurtel, Pawan Sarraf, Dipak Dumre, Kushal Malla, Lokesh Bam, Rashid Khan, Narayan Joshi, Aakash Chand, Shahab Alam, Bipin Khatri, Yuvraj Khatri, Rijan Dhakal.

Nepal T20 Squad (Asian Games): Rohit Kumar Paudel, Dipendra Singh Airee, Sompal Kami, Karan KC, Sandeep Lamichhane, Aarif Sheikh, Aasif Sheikh, Kushal Bhurtel, Lalit Rajbanshi, Gulsan Jha, Nandan Yadav, Lokesh Bam, Sundeep Jora, Sher Malla, Kushal Malla.
